the design of high energy intermediates analogues to study the role of sterols in plant membranes and to control sterol biosynthesis.
the development of new strategies for the design of potent inhibitors of plant enzymes involved in sterol biosynthesis and the study of their biological activities.
the design of new compounds with potential applications in agriculture, medicine and biotechnology.
